text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — my docs PR #1287 failed the docs preview CI. Linkcheck + Vale errors flagged. Preview: https://redwood-docs-preview/pr-1287

docs-ci-bot: [docs-preview] Build failed — linkcheck: 3 broken links; vale: 2 rule violations (no-contraction, acronym-style); spellcheck: 1 flagged word. See CI log: https://ci.redwood/1234/log

Samir Chen: can you paste the short linkcheck output?

Maya Patel: sure, excerpt below:

```
LinkCheck: ERROR Broken link: docs/migration/old-auth.md -> https://old-provider.example.com/auth-guide (404)
LinkCheck: WARNING Relative link points to non-existent anchor: docs/guides/embedding.md#usage-tips
LinkCheck: ERROR Broken link: docs/setup/regions.md -> https://cloud.example.com/regions (timeout)
```

Samir Chen: thanks — the first and third are external 404/timeouts, second is an internal anchor. Lina, can you take the external URL checks?

Lina Gomez: Yep. I'll try to find updated endpoints or add redirects. If upstream is gone we should mirror the short snippet into our guide and link to the Wayback as last resort.

Eli Thompson: I can handle the Vale/style bits. Which rules?

Maya Patel: vale reported:
```
docs/guides/migration.md: VALE: no-contraction: \"don't\" -> use \"do not\" (line 42)
docs/api/overview.md: VALE: acronym-style: recommended 'CPU' not 'Cpu' (line 12)
```

Samir Chen: quick options: (1) edit the content, (2) add a per-file override in .vale.ini for that path, or (3) add an inline comment to ignore that particular rule. Prefer (1) unless it's a deliberate style choice.

Maya Patel: I prefer (1) as well. I'll change \"don't\" -> \"do not\" in migration.md.

Eli Thompson: I'll patch the acronym styling in api/overview.md to use all-caps.

Samir Chen: For rerunning preview you can either push a new commit or trigger the docs CI bot with an empty commit: `git commit --allow-empty -m \"docs: retrigger preview\" && git push`. The bot also accepts `[docs preview]` in the commit message.

Maya Patel: working on a tiny fix now. Also updating the relative anchor in embedding.md to match the actual header.

Lina Gomez: FYI I found a replacement for the old auth guide: https://new-provider.example.com/authentication. I'll update the link and add a comment about deprecation. For the cloud regions timeout, I'm replacing with our internal status page link + note to check upstream.

Maya Patel: pushed changes at 1965432140: link fixes, wording tweak, anchor fix. Commit: `docs: fix linkcheck + wording for migration guide (#1287)`

docs-ci-bot: [docs-preview] Rebuild queued by maya.p. Rebuilding...

docs-ci-bot: [docs-preview] Build succeeded — linkcheck: 0 errors, vale: 0 violations, spellcheck: 0. Preview available: https://redwood-docs-preview/pr-1287/preview

Maya Patel: Great — thanks everyone. If you want to quickly review the tiny wording changes I'm still around.

Eli Thompson: LGTM, no further notes.

Lina Gomez: checked the links, they look good.

Samir Chen: merging when you're ready, Maya. Thanks for moving fast. :rocket:

Maya Patel: merging now. :tada:
